name: Reactor Core Salvage
description: A high-risk bio-reactive debris field awaits.|Deep in the irradiated zone lies a collapsed reactor with unstable energy-rich material. Only disciplined operators can extract it safely.

text: Runner, have you heard of the Reactor Core ruins?
Its debris carries dangerous but valuable energy.
If you want to find it, seek the Zone Guardian first.
Runner after the Reactor Core, why do you need its material?
Only stable hands should handle it.
Prove your control with a few field tasks.
Firstly, the mutants of this zone are restless.
Calm them by collecting the Rad-Away Serum nearby.
Bring me 5 of them, and I'll share the next step.
Well done! Now clear a rogue threat lurking in this zone.
Defeat it, and you'll prove you can keep balance here.
To find the Reactor Core, follow the glowing radiation trail.
Take only what you need and leave the rest stable.
completedText: Follow the path of radioactive markers.

text: You stand before me, Runner. Your intent is stable.
Take one small piece of my core, and use its power wisely.
You've done it! The Reactor Core's power is now yours to wield.
Use it wisely, and protect the balance of this sector.

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@You have just finished @crimson@Reactor Core Salvage@green@. The power of the Reactor Core is now in your hands!
